acquisition: All 71 required model artifacts and four synthetic graphs are directly in Git. Only the Elliptic dataset must be acquired through its provider; see docs/reproducibility/ELLIPTIC_MODELS.md. Historical raw GNN caches remain separately governed.
raw_elliptic: Obtain original licensed Elliptic data through its provider, then use the pinned baseline preprocessing and frozen manifests; new preprocessing is not an identity substitute.
fresh5: All ten exact FRESH5 checkpoint members are published in artifacts/checkpoints/elliptic/pgexplainer/fresh5. Original COMPLETE/Release002 archives remain optional dependencies of historical guard drivers, not of the model-only adapter.
